title: Choose the visual world for cerosoft.net
question: The roll assigned The Drawing Set. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drawing Set
options.lineage: Architectural construction drawings: sheet sets, title blocks, dimension lines, revision clouds
options.thesis: The site is a construction drawing set: your workflow is drawn as-is, then redrawn as-built, with CondoMate as the built sheet.
materials: drafting film on a ruled grid
dimension and leader callouts on real UI
options.viewport: Sheet A-00 'From Zero to Solution': an empty ruled site plan where Excel, LINE and paper are drawn dashed, and on scroll the solid system draws itself in; title block bottom-right holds the TH/EN toggle and 'Talk to us'.
options.risk: Can read as an engineering cliché if the drawings stay decorative instead of annotating real CondoMate screens.

raised.raise: State is carried by line form, not hue: dashed = today's manual workflow, solid = the built system, double = live in production.
Cero Cyan is reserved for one job only: the action and the live state. Everything else is ink.
Each CondoMate screen holds the full viewport in a pinned scroll with generous empty paper, then cuts to the next, instead of a 10-card gallery.
One control propagates across every sheet: the language toggle and the scroll redraw all annotations at once.

options.label: The Carbon Receipt Book
options.lineage: Thai carbon-copy receipt and voucher books (white, pink, yellow copies) with rubber stamps
options.thesis: The paper every Thai SME still writes by hand, torn copy by copy, becomes one system that never needs a carbon again.
options.viewport: A receipt-book page set as the headline form, its copies fanned underneath; the stamp 'From Zero to Solution' lands in cyan and the copies collapse into one CondoMate receipt screen.
options.risk: The most familiar idea for this audience and close to what a Thai SME brief would suggest first; can turn nostalgic if the paper outweighs the product.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: Every service and stage is a hairline tick on one off-centre rail.
options.viewport: A charcoal plate with the five stages as hairlines on a single rail.
options.case: Fuses with the process, but SME owners do not recognise a spectrogram and the offer gets abstract.
options.kept: State carried by line form instead of colour.
options.risk: Reads as a science instrument, not a business partner.

options.label: Punk Paste-up Zine
options.thesis: Messy work pasted up as a ransom-note flyer.
options.case: Clashes with 'modern, not flashy' and the trust a software buyer needs.
options.kept: One colour reserved only for the action.

options.label: Fashion Flagship
options.thesis: Product screens as slow full-bleed looks.
options.viewport: One screen full-bleed under a giant serif word.
options.case: Beautiful but distant: SME owners don't see themselves in luxury retail.
options.kept: Let one image hold the viewport in vast space.

options.label: Miura-fold Sheet
options.thesis: A small packet unfolds into the whole system.
options.viewport: A packet that unfolds on scroll.
options.case: A nice metaphor, but it explains nothing about workflows.
options.kept: One control propagates across the whole sheet.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The site as a typed transcript.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor typing the tagline.
options.case: A developer costume that scares non-technical owners.
options.kept: System states print themselves instead of appearing as chrome.
options.risk: Exactly the jargon the brand avoids.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Projects mature like jars over days.
options.case: No connection to software for SMEs.
options.kept: Every item carries the same standard label band.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean software-agency site: hero, services cards, case study, process, contact, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA beside a CondoMate device mockup.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other software studio by design.
